subject: Invitation: co-present at Redwood Live — Novum Health reference webinar
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Olivia Hayes <olivia@novumhealth.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 7 Oct 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Invitation: co-present at Redwood Live — Novum Health reference webinar

Hi Olivia,

Hope you're doing well — quick ask. We're putting together a short customer reference webinar for our Redwood Live series in November (30–40 minute slot + live Q&A). We'd love to feature Novum Health for a 20-minute case study segment focused on how your team reduced per-token costs and improved latency for clinical workflows after migrating to Redwood Dedicated.

High level:
- Format: 20-minute joint presentation (Novum + Redwood) + 10–15 minute live Q&A
- Audience: engineering leads and platform owners at healthcare orgs (200–500 registrants expected)
- Proposed dates: week of Nov 17 (flexible)

We can handle slides and production — ask is whether Novum would be willing to co-present and share a few metrics and lessons learned. Draft agenda and a speaker release attached for legal.

If this sounds reasonable I can loop in Vivek from CS to coordinate technical talking points and Laura to help with marketing copy.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Senior Sales Manager, Redwood Inference
ben@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0213
Redwood Inference

Hi Ben — thanks for the invite, this sounds great. I'm looping in Dr. Priya Mehta (head of engineering on our platform team) who would likely present the technical side. A couple quick Qs:

1) Who specifically will be in the audience? Our compliance team will want a sense of attendee mix.
2) Are you looking for metrics we can share publicly? We can provide aggregated latency and cost delta numbers but would prefer no raw patient data or anything that mentions customers.
3) Rough timing — we prefer late-afternoon PST on a weekday (after 2pm).

Happy to participate if the scope is ok. Priya, any initial thoughts?

Best,
Olivia Hayes
Director, Product & Partnerships | Novum Health
olivia@novumhealth.com

Hi Ben / Olivia — thanks for the details. Novum confirms we can participate and prefer Thu, Nov 20 at 3:00pm PST.

I'm attaching a short bio and the internal slide deck we'll use as a source (we will send a redacted public deck by the slide deadline). Our public-friendly bullets:
- How we reduced tail latency by ~27% for clinical inference paths
- Batching and KV cache changes that lowered per-token inference cost by ~32% without degrading quality
- Key operational lessons: pinning model versions, using prefix caching, and canarying quantized variants

We can share the aggregated numbers you need — please send the marketing blurb and a sample slide template. Also confirm the final slide deadline (we prefer at least 7 days before the event).

Thanks — Priya
